# Aaryan Srivastava

Personal portfolio of Aaryan Srivastava, a University of Michigan student and builder/researcher working across AI, political science, law, institutions, and data systems.

Primary pages:
- / — About, work experience, and leadership
- /projects/ — IRENE, NoScroll, scheduling automation, legal analytics, WWI service data, Visionary Summit, ADN, and AgentShare
- /papers/ — Published research papers
- /resume/ — Resume

Selected research project:
- /projects/wwi-service-dataset/ — Research-assistant OCR and document extraction for Ohio WWI rosters, with source images, validation, and advisor review; 23 volumes and 249,597 processed roster records. Death annotations remain a review set.
